desc_english: Take your company public with an IPO.
desc_turkish: Şirketini halka arz et.
desc_german: Bring dein Unternehmen per Börsengang an die Börse.

desc_english: Grow your company to a value of ₺250M.
desc_turkish: Şirketinin değerini 250 M ₺'ye çıkar.
desc_german: Steigere den Wert deines Unternehmens auf 250 Mio. ₺.

desc_english: Grow the holding's total value to ₺500M: every city and the treasury.
desc_turkish: Holding'in toplam değerini 500 M ₺'ye çıkar: bütün şehirler ve kasa.
desc_german: Steigere den Gesamtwert der Holding auf 500 Mio. ₺: alle Städte und die Holding-Kasse.

desc_english: Found a holding: open a company in another city too.
desc_turkish: Holding kur: başka bir şehirde de şirket aç.
desc_german: Gründe eine Holding: Eröffne auch in einer anderen Stadt ein Unternehmen.

desc_english: Win in three of the holding's cities.
desc_turkish: Holding'in üç şehrinde zafer kazan.
desc_german: Siege in drei Städten der Holding.

desc_english: Win in a city: reach the difficulty's target value and first place, or take over every rival.
desc_turkish: Bir şehirde zafer kazan: zorluğun hedef değeri ve birincilik ya da bütün rakipleri devralmak.
desc_german: Siege in einer Stadt: Erreiche den Zielwert des Schwierigkeitsgrads und Platz eins oder übernimm alle Rivalen.

desc_english: On Balanced or Ruthless, win before the city's 500th day.
desc_turkish: Dengeli ya da Acımasız'da, şehrin 500. gününden önce zafer kazan.
desc_german: Siege auf Ausgewogen oder Gnadenlos vor dem 500. Tag der Stadt.

desc_english: Win on Ruthless.
desc_turkish: Acımasız'da zafer kazan.
desc_german: Siege auf Gnadenlos.

desc_english: Win in a large city.
desc_turkish: Büyük şehirde zafer kazan.
desc_german: Siege in einer Großstadt.

desc_english: On Balanced or Ruthless, win with at least two extra rules.
desc_turkish: Dengeli ya da Acımasız'da, en az iki ek kuralla zafer kazan.
desc_german: Siege auf Ausgewogen oder Gnadenlos mit mindestens zwei Zusatzregeln.

desc_english: On Balanced or Ruthless, win with all four extra rules on.
desc_turkish: Dengeli ya da Acımasız'da, dört ek kuralın hepsi açıkken zafer kazan.
desc_german: Siege auf Ausgewogen oder Gnadenlos, während alle vier Zusatzregeln aktiv sind.

desc_english: Win with three different CEOs.
desc_turkish: Üç farklı CEO ile zafer kazan.
desc_german: Siege mit drei verschiedenen CEOs.

desc_english: Win by three different paths: retail, takeovers, real estate, energy or freight.
desc_turkish: Üç farklı yoldan zafer kazan: perakende, devralma, gayrimenkul, enerji ya da nakliye.
desc_german: Siege auf drei verschiedenen Wegen: Einzelhandel, Übernahmen, Immobilien, Energie oder Fracht.

desc_english: Buy more than half of a rival's shares: the company becomes yours.
desc_turkish: Bir rakibin hisselerinin yarısından fazlasını topla: şirketi senin olur.
desc_german: Kauf mehr als die Hälfte der Aktien eines Rivalen: Das Unternehmen gehört dir.

desc_english: Take over five companies in a single run.
desc_turkish: Tek bir koşuda beş şirket devral.
desc_german: Übernimm in einer einzigen Partie fünf Unternehmen.

desc_english: Be the only company left in a city: take over every rival.
desc_turkish: Bir şehirde tek şirket kal: bütün rakipleri devral.
desc_german: Sei das einzige verbliebene Unternehmen einer Stadt: Übernimm alle Rivalen.

desc_english: Push a raider who gathered 25% of your shares back below 10%.
desc_turkish: Hisselerinin %25'ini toplayan bir baskıncıyı %10'un altına geri it.
desc_german: Drück einen Angreifer, der 25 % deiner Aktien gesammelt hat, wieder unter 10 %.

desc_english: Break up a rival partnership formed against you: with your value, your investment or a shield.
desc_turkish: Sana karşı kurulan rakip ortaklığını dağıt: değerinle, yatırımınla ya da kalkanla.
desc_german: Sprenge ein Bündnis von Rivalen, das sich gegen dich gebildet hat: mit deinem Wert, deinen Investitionen oder einem Schutzschild.

desc_english: Make it through a crisis still standing.
desc_turkish: Bir krizi ayakta bitir.
desc_german: Komm aufrecht durch eine Krise.

desc_english: End a crisis worth more than on the day it began.
desc_turkish: Bir krizi, başladığı günden daha değerli bitir.
desc_german: Geh aus einer Krise wertvoller hervor als an ihrem ersten Tag.

desc_english: Become the lead sponsor of a city project.
desc_turkish: Bir şehir projesinin ana sponsoru ol.
desc_german: Werde Hauptsponsor eines Stadtprojekts.

desc_english: Have the side you lobbied for win five votes (across all runs).
desc_turkish: Lobi yaptığın taraf beş oylamada kazansın (bütün koşular).
desc_german: Verhilf der Seite, für die du Lobbyarbeit gemacht hast, zu fünf gewonnenen Abstimmungen (über alle Partien).

desc_english: Deliver five municipal contracts (across all runs).
desc_turkish: Beş belediye sözleşmesi teslim et (bütün koşular).
desc_german: Erfülle fünf städtische Verträge (über alle Partien).

desc_english: Win ten plot auctions (across all runs).
desc_turkish: On parsel ihalesi kazan (bütün koşular).
desc_german: Gewinne zehn Grundstücksauktionen (über alle Partien).

desc_english: Catch fifty opportunity bubbles (across all runs).
desc_turkish: Elli fırsat balonu yakala (bütün koşular).
desc_german: Schnapp dir fünfzig Gelegenheitsblasen (über alle Partien).

desc_english: Complete twenty-five monthly quests (across all runs).
desc_turkish: Yirmi beş aylık görev tamamla (bütün koşular).
desc_german: Schließe fünfundzwanzig Monatsaufträge ab (über alle Partien).

desc_english: Earn at least one star in every scenario.
desc_turkish: Her senaryodan en az bir yıldız al.
desc_german: Hol dir in jedem Szenario mindestens einen Stern.

desc_english: Collect every scenario star.
desc_turkish: Senaryoların bütün yıldızlarını topla.
desc_german: Sammle alle Szenario-Sterne.

desc_english: Play a week of the Seed League to the end.
desc_turkish: Tohum Ligi'nde bir haftayı sonuna kadar oyna.
desc_german: Spiel eine Woche der Seed-Liga bis zum Ende.
